title: NHK Web やさしい日本語 — コンビニの進化 (The Evolution of Convenience Stores)
description: NHK Web Easy news segment on Japan's konbini (convenience store) culture. Japan has over 55,000 convenience stores — one for every 2,300 people — and they have evolved far beyond selling snacks: they now handle tax payments, ATM services, package delivery, printing, and disaster relief coordination. N5–N4 vocabulary with modern loanwords.
